Hi Elliot / Maya —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As promised, attaching a first-pass MAP that maps your evaluation milestones to objective pass/fail checks and the rollout orchestration we recommend. High-level goals here are:

- Give you a compact set of reproducible acceptance tests (the "passbench") you can run in a week-long trial.
- Define explicit stoplight gates (green/amber/red) tied to KPIs so go/no-go decisions are unambiguous.
- Outline the operational handoff for cutover if you choose to move to Dedicated.

Key acceptance signals in the spreadsheet (HP_MAP_v1.0.xlsx):
- Latency P95 <= 350ms for 512 token requests under your 30 qps test (green); amber if 350-500ms; red >500ms.
- Generation concordance: exact-answer recall >= 92% on the 5k seed prompt set (green); amber 85–91%; red <85%.
- Safety regression: flagged false-positive rate <= 0.5% on your moderated corpus.
- Throughput sustain: 90-minute sustained run at 25 qps without >2% error rate.

Acceptance tests (passbench-smoke-tests.md) include: canonical prompt pack (1. sampling seed, 2. deterministic regen, 3. adversarial injection), end-to-end traces with token-level timing, and a quick model-fallback checklist to validate graceful degradation.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Day 0: MAP shared, environment creds provided to HealthPrime (we host sandbox endpoint).
- Day 1–2: Sanity & smoke tests (fast signal).
- Day 3–6: Full passbench run (performance + concordance + safety).
- Day 7: Decision call and signoff.

Attachments: HP_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (MAP), passbench-smoke-tests.md (test runner instructions), demo-20260610.mp4 (recording).

Please review and call out any missing signals you want measured. If this looks good I’ll lock v1 and schedule the environment handoff for Monday morning.

Thanks —
